demos.title: Audit Core Web Vitals
demos.teaches: Measure LCP, INP, CLS, FCP and TTFB live with PerformanceObserver and reproduce them in a Lighthouse lab run.

demos.title: Profile with Angular DevTools
demos.teaches: Record a Chrome performance trace with enableProfiling(), read the Angular track, and turn a shape in the flame chart into a fix.

demos.title: Optimize Bundles with Rolldown
demos.teaches: Read the Rolldown build pipeline of @angular/build, enforce size budgets, and keep heavy libraries out of the initial chunk.

demos.title: Defer Non-Critical Views
demos.teaches: Split a template with @defer blocks, drive them with interaction, viewport and when triggers, and prefetch on idle.

demos.title: Compare Defer Triggers
demos.teaches: Run all seven @defer triggers side by side and measure the chunk each one pulls, in bytes and in milliseconds.

demos.title: Zoneless Change Detection
demos.teaches: See what schedules a refresh without zone.js: signal writes and template listeners do, a bare setTimeout does not.

demos.title: Configure Zoneless
demos.teaches: Run without zone.js using provideZonelessChangeDetection() so change detection is scheduled by signals and events.

demos.title: Virtual Scroll Large Lists
demos.teaches: Render 100000 rows with the CDK virtual scroll viewport and watch the rendered range instead of the whole list.

demos.title: Optimize Images
demos.teaches: Use NgOptimizedImage for srcset generation, reserved layout space, lazy loading and a single prioritized LCP image.

demos.title: Build Accessible UI
demos.teaches: Meet WCAG 2.2 AA for the European Accessibility Act with @angular/aria widgets, template lint rules and an axe scan.

demos.title: Harden with Strict CSP
demos.teaches: Generate a hash-based strict Content Security Policy with the security.autoCsp build option and watch violations.

demos.title: Gate Third-Party Content
demos.teaches: Block analytics and external media until consent is granted, and make withdrawal as easy as granting.

demos.title: Load Scripts After Consent
demos.teaches: Inject third-party tags only once consent exists, prove it from the resource timeline, and handle withdrawal honestly.

demos.title: Audit Dependencies and Licenses
demos.teaches: Inventory runtime dependencies, their licences and their obligations, and fail CI on new advisories.

demos.title: Gate the Pull Request
demos.teaches: Fail the build on budgets, template accessibility lint, an axe scan and Lighthouse CI, with a workflow that blocks the merge.

markdownItems.title: Budget the initial bundle
markdownItems.comment: An initial chunk over 1 MB is a warning worth reading, not a threshold to raise.

markdownItems.title: Defer below the fold
markdownItems.comment: @defer with a viewport trigger keeps heavy views out of the first paint.
